meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Cross-checked ready-first provider selection, bounded cooldown and native tool routing against the updated runtime and observability docs. Protected files remain scoped to PHP.

auth.review_note: Verified configured owner authentication, session regeneration and flash persistence before native response finalization and confirmed other login paths retain their routes.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the downloaded file resolver and schema field against the source contracts for product orders and payments. This route uses the authored page publication and enquiry grant.

content.review_note: Cross-checked revision-aware campaign download authorization and its documented storage. The Dashboard reads storefront events through a separate audit projection.

foundation.review_note: Cross-checked the single streamed audit SELECT, strictly typed bridge counts and campaign file storage. Updated the review fingerprints for the combined source.

google-tags.review_note: Compared the updated integration and provider examples with the Google reporting and analytics contracts, and cross-reviewed native download links against the frontend skill.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the front-controller and Apache path guards, private resolution and upload errors with the shared request-boundary documentation.

interface.review_note: Compared the normal owner redirect and dashboard activity states with the admin guide. Protected download controls and their layout remain present.

mail.review_note: Compared configured-owner session close, redirect and one notice attempt with the mail guide. The dashboard telemetry read has no mail side effects.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Reviewed the independent private download storage against the existing owner Media Library, header image and deletion documentation. Download files keep their own private root.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the owner dashboard counter states and protected-download guidance after the configured-owner login response change.

public-mcp.review_note: Cross-checked the regenerated Dashboard and authored page map with Public MCP and A2UI. The audit count remains an authenticated database operation.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the authenticated storefront count independently of the existing cart, checkout and campaign write contracts.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the regenerated map and source receipts after the owner login merge. The existing MySQL and MariaDB checks exercise direct and bridge storefront counts.
